svg.title: Every reading the specimen's two attention heads made while it learned.
svg.desc: The corpus "to be or not to be" lies along the baseline (value ticks mark letters, gaps mark spaces). Reader i reading source j < i with weight A[i,j] is an arc from j to i of height span × weight; head 1 above the line, head 2 below. 40 moments of training (AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1), later moments inked more strongly. Head 1 learns short, local readings; head 2 learns to reach far back.
